title: Spring Awakening
imageAlt: Oil painting of a forest stream running past mossy, snow-dusted rocks under birch trees glowing pink and gold in morning light
description: The first warm morning of March, when the snow lets go of the rocks and the whole forest seems to exhale. I painted the light in thin, glowing layers so the birches feel like they are holding the sunrise.

title: Clouds Over Still Water
imageAlt: Tall oil painting of towering white cumulus clouds above a calm turquoise lake with a small white sailboat
description: A July afternoon when the clouds grew taller than anything on the horizon. The clouds are built with thick palette-knife strokes, the water with soft glazes, so the sky feels heavy and the lake feels weightless.

title: Peonies in a White Jug
imageAlt: Oil painting of pale pink and cream peonies in a simple white ceramic jug against a warm ivory background
description: My grandmother grew peonies by her porch in Ukraine. Every June I paint them again, loosely and quickly, before the petals fall, the way she taught me to enjoy things while they last.

title: Golden Field
imageAlt: Oil painting of a golden wheat field with blue cornflowers under a wide summer sky with soft clouds
description: Blue sky, golden wheat. A painting about home, and about the fields I grew up beside. It now lives with a family in Evanston.

title: Lemons and Linen
imageAlt: Still life oil painting of lemons, a white linen cloth and a glass carafe on a wooden table in soft side light
description: A study in quiet: the folds of linen, the cool glass, the sharp yellow of lemons. I painted it slowly over many mornings, chasing the same window light each day.

title: Lake Michigan at Dawn
imageAlt: Oil painting of the Lake Michigan shoreline at dawn with gentle waves, dune grasses and a lavender and peach sky
description: Chicago gave me a new kind of horizon. On early walks along the lake, the water and sky melt into one pale color, and this painting is my attempt to hold that minute before the city wakes up.

title: Lilacs by the Window
imageAlt: Oil painting of purple and white lilac branches in a glass vase beside an open window with a light curtain
description: In May the whole apartment smells of lilac. I left the brushwork open and airy here, so the flowers feel like they are moving in the breeze from the window.

title: Birch Grove in October
imageAlt: Oil painting of a misty birch grove in autumn with golden leaves and a narrow path leading into the trees
description: Birches are the trees of my childhood. This grove was painted in warm ochres and soft olive greens, layered until the mist felt real.

title: Three Pears
imageAlt: Still life oil painting of three green and blush pears beside a small copper bowl on a cream tablecloth
description: Three pears, a little copper bowl, and a lot of patience. Still life teaches me to look closely at ordinary things until they start to glow.

title: Sunflowers at Golden Hour
imageAlt: Oil painting of a field of sunflowers at golden hour under a soft hazy sky, painted with thick textured brushstrokes
description: Sunflowers always turn toward the light, and so do we. Painted with thick, textured strokes you can feel with your fingertips.

title: Winter River
imageAlt: Oil painting of a quiet winter river winding through snowy fields under a pale pink sunset with bare willow trees
description: Snow is never white. It is pink, lilac and blue, depending on the hour. This river was painted almost entirely in those quiet in-between colors.

title: Wild Roses
imageAlt: Oil painting of pink wild roses climbing a weathered white fence in dappled summer light
description: A neighbor's fence in Oak Park, covered in roses for exactly two weeks each June. Dappled light, loose petals, and a little bit of summer to keep.
